name: convergence_build_forks
description: Convergence spike (roadmap H1/H4): one wave of ownership-GATED dispatch. From the pending items, dispatch only those whose shared files are all free on the blackboard (claiming each dispatched item's files); items blocked by a live owner stay in 'remaining' for the next wave, so two agents never hold the same shared file concurrently. Each dispatched fork reuses code_subtask, rooted at the moving shared branch head.

repoPath.description: The shared run worktree; each fork's own worktree is created under it, rooted at the shared branch head.

correlationId.description: Run id under which contract/ownership facts are recorded on the shared blackboard.

subtasks.description: The still-pending work items for this wave [{id, description, files}]; files deliberately overlap across items.

contractPaths.description: Repository-relative files that form the frozen contract; forks are told to build against, never edit, these.

codeModel.description: Model id passed through to each fork's coding agent.

dynamicTasks.description: FORK_JOIN_DYNAMIC descriptors, one code_subtask per item.

dynamicTasksInput.description: Per-fork input map keyed by subtask id.

groupIds.description: Comma-separated ids dispatched THIS wave, in fork order.

contractPaths.description: The frozen contract paths echoed back for the integrator.

dispatched.description: Items dispatched this wave as [{id, description, files, attempt}] — passed to the integrator so it can release ownership and re-queue failed ones with attempt+1.

remaining.description: Pending items blocked by a live owner this wave; carried to the next wave.

forkCount.description: Number of forks dispatched this wave.

remainingCount.description: Number of items deferred to the next wave.
